title: Quarantine, repair and restore
summary: Quarantine unsafe clock data, repair only from peer evidence, and make backup restore force a clean attach.
produces: Restore behavior that drops sync baselines

conditions: Repair reads no local clock and changes only permitted fields.
Unrepairable records remain quarantined rather than being guessed.
Restore forces a fresh attach, preserves and revalidates deletions, and reruns normalization.
Quarantine, repair, and restore converge under the conformance vectors.
